messages:
eva: Heads-up — last night around 02:12 UTC we saw a cluster of requests that hit project quota and then were routed to the service-account path and started failing 503. Need a quick policy + UX decision so this doesn't silently break customers.

maria: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc/sa-fallback?panelId=5 Observed fallback_ratio ~ 8% for ~30m, and fallback_error_rate ~ 18% on that path.

sam: Ouch. We should avoid silent org-level fallbacks that break attribution. Billing & quota attribution are primary concerns for enterprise tenants.

tony: Agreed. Two high-level levers:
1) Fail early at the project boundary (clear signal, surface to app).
2) Soft-fallback to org/sa with strict throttling and telemetry (keeps apps alive but muddies billing).

nish: I sketched a config prototype we could use as a starting point:

```yaml
routing:
  fallback_order: [project, org, service_account]
  fallback_throttles:
    service_account: { qps: 50, burst: 100 }
  telemetry:
    fallback_sample_rate: 0.1
    emit_tag: fallback_path
```

My preference: default to deny for paid/enterprise customers, opt-in fallback for PLG to reduce customer impact.

sam: +1 for opt-in. Also need console affordances — a per-tenant toggle and clear metrics: `fallback_ratio` and `fallback_error_rate`. We should make those first-class in the dashboard.

maria: We also need this surfaced during rollouts. When we change quotas or routing rules, the canary should show `fallback_ratio` spikes before we open to all users.

eva: Minimal UX mock: a checkbox "Allow cross-project fallback" with an info tooltip and a link to docs. Show current `fallback_ratio` and last_1h delta next to it.

tony: Telemetry event proposal (small payload):

```
event: routing_fallback
attrs:
  src_key_type: project_key
  target_key_type: service_account
  reason: quota_exceeded
  success: false
  latency_ms: 32
```

Include `billing_project` tag for rollups.

maria: Quick implement plan:
- eng-platform: add fallback flags + throttles to routing service (nish + tony)
- eng-runtime: emit metrics + sampled debug payloads (sam)
- console: add toggle + metric card (eva)
- product: define default for paid vs free tiers (maria)

Timeline: aim to start a small canary next week, iterate.

deploy-bot: Canary job created: `canary/fallback-policy/2026-06-01-08:00-UTC` (assigned to eng-platform)

sam: I'll own runtime metrics & sampled payloads, will post PR early next week.

eva: Thanks. I'll prototype the console toggle and metric card. I'll also add the change to #kanban and tag product for defaults. Reconvene after canary metrics. :eyes:
